notes:
- Fixes in-app updates: the helper that copies the new files in after you choose Install and restart never started, so updates from 1.3.2 and 1.4.0 did nothing. It now starts correctly, runs without any window, logs to `update-install.log` in the install folder, and shows a normal message box if something goes wrong.
- Copies of 1.3.2 and 1.4.0 cannot update themselves (the faulty helper is part of those versions): install this release once from the download page. Setup keeps your settings, queue and history, and clears the leftover "update in progress" lock a failed attempt may have left behind. Updates from 1.4.1 onward are in-app again.
- Browser extension 0.2.1: Chrome and Edge no longer show the warning about `background.scripts`. Open extension folder now also creates a separate `browser-extension-firefox` folder with the manifest Firefox needs.
- Includes everything from 1.4.0: the in-page Download button with a quality menu, the System accent color option and the guided scheduling editor.

Windows x64 only for installer updates. Download only media you have permission to save. No DRM bypass. Builds are unsigned.
